title: HelperSSHTrustHostKeyParams
description: The helper asking the coordinator to RECORD a host key it has already been told to accept. The decision is not made here and cannot be: it travels in the probe's acceptOnTrust, set by the caller that has done whatever it does before a first connection, and the write lands in the coordinator's known_hosts through the single write path this repository has for it (ssh.RealClient.TrustHostKey). A helper that asks for this without being told to is asking for the same write any same-UID process on that machine could make for itself (D12), which is the trust model stated rather than a hole in it.

host.description: The storage identity, as in verify-host-key: the address for a direct route, the coordinator's own opaque route digest for a jump route.

algorithm.description: The offered key's own type string, checked against the key bytes for the same reason it is on the verify half.

key.description: The wire-format public key blob to record, base64. Public material, echoed from the handshake.
